title: Tool Use & Function Calling
subtitle: Defining tools and parsing structured outputs

content.text: Tools (function calling) let the LLM request data or actions from your code. The model returns a structured tool call; you execute it and return the result.
Define clear, specific tool descriptions. The model decides whether and when to call tools based on them.

questions.question: Who executes the tool when an LLM requests a function call?
questions.explanation: The LLM returns a structured tool call request. Your code runs the actual function and returns the result.

faq.q: Can I give a model multiple tools?
faq.a: Yes. Pass an array of tool definitions. The model will choose the most appropriate one, or none if it can answer without a tool.

examples: LLM assistant that searches a product database via tool calls
